statement: The affine kinematic variety SE_3⊂C16 has dimension six and degree 40. In the coordinates (r,x,y,M), each of the six fixed-length leg constraints is the linear equation (4). For general platform/base geometry and lengths their intersection is zero-dimensional with 40 complex assembly configurations. Theorem 5.1 independently gives deg(SE_3)=deg(SO_4)=40 for this embedding.

answer.text: The generic complex assembly count is 40.

notes:
Special mechanisms can have fewer isolated configurations or positive-dimensional fibres. The degree assertion is tied to the augmented embedding and the justified generic leg sections.

scope: General spatial Stewart–Gough six-leg geometry, with each leg condition expressed as a hyperplane in the augmented SE_3 embedding.
